name: TSDB

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
## What's changed

- Keeps recent instant-vector PromQL queries fast on large stores by reading only samples that an evaluation step can observe.
- Runs compaction, retention, and incremental vacuum as bounded, adaptive background slices instead of doing major maintenance at database open or workspace-ready.
- Prioritizes foreground queries and ingests ahead of queued maintenance, with adaptive pauses when queries are active or waiting.
- Adds compaction catch-up behavior for old idle backlogs so maintenance can outpace sustained ingestion without sacrificing foreground responsiveness.
- Exposes queue, compaction, retention, and vacuum timing/backlog metrics for live performance diagnosis.
- Addresses Obsidian plugin-review warnings for success-path console logging, thrown error values, and DOM element creation.

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
## What's changed

- Defers SQLite, WebAssembly, metric scans, scraping, retention, and panel refresh until Obsidian's workspace is ready, keeping plugin startup light.
- Lazily decodes the embedded WebAssembly and emits `tsdb:ready` only after storage and scraping are available.
- Evaluates PromQL beside SQLite in the OPFS worker and transfers final query results back to the renderer.
- Improves OPFS startup retries, storage failure reporting, teardown behavior, and bounded retention work.
- Refreshes the README with the dashboard workflow, screenshot, storage guidance, and contribution/release documentation.
